note: TRD superchargers were dealer-installed and are excluded from the engine lists: gen1 3.4 V6 (~260 hp) and 4.7 V8 kits (Wikipedia) and the gen2 5.7 kit, 504 hp / 550 lb-ft, 2008-2015 (MotorAuthority, Wikipedia; Toyota warranty only when a Toyota dealer installed it). The TRD Performance Package (421 / 469 hp) is different: Toyota installs it before delivery to the dealer with full factory warranty, so it is listed for 2024 and 2026. EPA 2025 shows no TRD rows, so 2025 is not listed. Toyota re-rated for 2006 under revised SAE J1349: 4.0 V6 245 -> 236 hp, 4.7 V8 282 -> 271 hp; each year carries the figure published for that model year. cid values are liters converted and rounded, not factory figures. NHRA has no Tundra rows.
